values.flight_rule_purpose: Pre-agreed operational constraints and contingency actions vetted before flight to protect crew, station and hardware without real-time guesswork.

aurora_role_to_mcc_console_map.Kai (Power & Heat): SPARTAN / EECOM (Station Power, Articulation, Thermal, and Analysis)
aurora_role_to_mcc_console_map.Amara (Atmosphere & Verification): ECLSS / ETHOS (Environmental and Thermal Operating Systems)

go_nogo_poll_states: GO: domain meets all Flight Rules and reserves
GO WITH ADVISORY: Flight Rules met, but a soft science/comfort margin is reduced
NO-GO: a Flight Rule or mandatory safety check is violated (blocks Commit or triggers pre-loaded abort)

derived.name: game_flight_rules

value.FR-01: Crew First, Science Second (A > 0 and crew sheltered override plant health H)
value.FR-02: Minimum Air & Protected Trunk (A > 0; MAIN trunk isolation interlocked; breathing N/4 per shift)
value.FR-03: Storm Shelter & EVA Hatch Interlock (Safe Room mandatory on alarm; Z <= 3 in CH1, Z <= 6 in CH7; two post-storm readings < 1.0 before EVA)
value.FR-04: Protected Power Bus & Eclipse Reserve (E >= 0 avoids blackout; 7 of 14 E reserved in P-11; main bus interlocked in P-12)
value.FR-05: Rover Slope & Return Reserve (slope <= 15 deg; reserve >= 30/100 in P-07, >= 2/14 and 51 h <= 72 h in P-15; brake before repair)
value.FR-06: Calibration & Containment Before Commit (two-point zero/span in P-01/P-07; sealed interlock in P-03; 3-stage dry warm-up in P-08)

derived.formula: Pre-agreed constraints enforced by console interlocks and shift checkpoints
derived.drives: P-01 to P-16 Flight Rule banners, hard interlocks and Class Mode (M1-37) Go/No-Go polls

boundary: Adapts NASA JSC Mission Control Flight Rules and console polling for a four-cadet cooperative trainer.
